sections.title: 1. Agreement & Eligibility
sections.text: By accessing or using AirPoker, you agree to these terms. You must be of legal age in your jurisdiction to use this service. If you do not agree, please do not use the application.

sections.title: 2. Game Data & Virtual Chips
sections.text: AirPoker provides virtual chips exclusively for tracking live poker games. No real money is handled, processed, or facilitated by the Service. Any financial agreements, side bets, or wagers made between players outside of the application are their sole responsibility. We disclaim all liability regarding offline agreements.

sections.title: 3. Privacy & Accounts
sections.text: AirPoker offers a completely anonymous Guest access that does not require or store personal data (using browser Local Storage only to keep the session active). If you choose to register an account to save your progress, we securely store your email, unique username, and password hash (or social login ID via providers like Google) solely to save your cumulative stats, table history, and manage your friends list.

sections.title: 4. Acceptable Use
sections.text: You agree not to misuse the Service. This includes attempting to disrupt the servers, reverse engineer the platform, or use it to facilitate unlicenced and illegal gambling operations.

sections.title: 5. Availability & "As Is"
sections.text: The Service is provided "as is" without any warranties. We do not guarantee continuous availability and are not responsible for any service interruptions, loss of game data, or table resets due to technical issues, connection drops, or unexpected outages.

sections.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
sections.text: To the maximum extent permitted by law, AirPoker and its creators are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of the Service.

sections.title: 7. Changes
sections.text: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the Service constitutes your acceptance of the new terms.

about.title: About AirPoker
about.missionText: AirPoker was born to eliminate the frustration of counting, carrying, and splitting physical chips during poker nights. Whether you prefer the tactile feel of real cards or the convenience of a 100% digital game, we've got you covered.
about.step1: 1. Physical Cards: Grab a real deck and use AirPoker only for tracking chips, blinds, and pots.
about.step2: 2. Virtual Cards: Let the system deal the cards and automatically calculate the winners.
about.step3: 3. Join via smartphone: No app downloads required—play instantly as a guest or sign up to save your data.
about.step4: 4. Automated Showdown: In virtual mode, the game engine instantly evaluates winners and side-pots with zero margin for error.
about.step5: 5. History & Statistics: Register to save your wins, analyze your performance, view details of past tables, and see how you rank in the community.
about.feature1: Zero physical chips. Travel light and play anywhere.
about.feature2: Professional Calculation Engine. Perfect management of complex split-pots and side-pots in real-time.
about.feature3: Pro Dealer Protocol. In virtual mode, we follow professional rules, including 'burn cards' before every street.
about.feature4: 100% Free. No ads or in-app purchases. Play freely as a guest or create an account.
about.feature5: Registered Profile & Friends. Track your historical progress, customize your gaming avatar, send friend requests, and view your rivals' statistics.
